title: Order status as an Enum
hints: Calling the class with a value looks up the member: `OrderStatus("paid")` is `OrderStatus.PAID`, and an unknown value raises `ValueError` on its own.
Iterating over an Enum class gives its members in definition order, so `list(OrderStatus)` is the whole workflow. `members.index(self)` tells you where you are.

`parse_status`: `return OrderStatus(raw.strip().lower())`. `advance`: `members = list(OrderStatus)`, `i = members.index(self)`, raise `ValueError("... final ...")` if it's the last one, else `return members[i + 1]`.
